about_the_game:
A stage-based puzzle game with a top-down & isometric view, centered around the concepts of rooms and doors.

In Door Puzzle, players place puzzle pieces according to specific rules to create logical connections — offering an experience that is both intuitive and deeply satisfying.

Key Features

  • Convincing puzzle design using rooms and doors
    Realistic spatial rules and connection structures lead to unique problem-solving paths.

  • Connect rooms by following door rules
    A room door connects two indoor spaces. A garden door connects two outdoor spaces. A front door connects indoor and outdoor spaces.

  • Jigsaw puzzle UX meets Minesweeper-style logic
    New types of reasoning are required as the puzzle progresses, creating stage-by-stage immersion.

  • Visually expanding stage design
    Previous stages remain visually present, reinforcing a growing sense of accomplishment.

Platform & Development Info

  • Engine: Unity

  • Development Status: Approximately 80% complete

  • Release: Global launch planned for the second half of 2025
